name: HDR-GS Tone Mapping via MLP
definition: A method to model the inverse tone-mapping function for HDR-GS by transforming the input signal to a logarithmic domain to enhance MLP training stability, avoiding nonlinearity and discontinuity issues in the linear domain.
summary: HDR-GS Tone Mapping via MLP parameterizes the Camera Response Function as a learnable neural network, enabling joint optimization with scene representation for stable, high-fidelity high dynamic range Gaussian Splatting.
